question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.

SELECT 
  SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
  c.category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
  ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
  ROUND(s.total_selling_price, 2) AS total_selling_price,
  ROUND(l.avg_loss_rate, 2) AS average_loss_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
  ROUND(s.total_selling_price - SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS profit
FROM veg_whsle_df w
JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    c2.category_name,
    SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") AS total_selling_price
  FROM veg_txn_df t
  JOIN veg_cat c2 ON t.item_code = c2.item_code
  WHERE t."sale/return" = 'sale'
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4), c2.category_name
) s ON SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) = s.year AND c.category_name = s.category_name
JOIN (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(w2.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    c3.category_name,
    AVG(l2."loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate
  FROM veg_whsle_df w2
  JOIN veg_cat c3 ON w2.item_code = c3.item_code
  JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l2 ON w2.item_code = l2.item_code
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(w2.whsle_date, 1, 4), c3.category_name
) l ON SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) = l.year AND c.category_name = l.category_name
WHERE SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4), c.category_name, s.total_selling_price, l.avg_loss_rate
ORDER BY year, category_name
